legalName: Summit Home Services of Florida, Inc.
tagline: Plumbing, electrical, HVAC — three trades, one contractor.

hours.sourceNote: Regular counter hours; emergency HVAC dispatch line covers nights and weekends at surcharge.

ownership.ownerSource: About page; Greg founded 2003, Marissa joined as VP of operations 2010.

yearsInBusiness.evidence: Florida Secretary of State corporation registration 2003; CFC plumbing license issue date 2003-05; About page cites founding year.

services.name: Panel Upgrades and Replacements
services.description: 200-amp and 400-amp residential panel upgrades, meter main replacements, and subpanel additions. Permit pulling and utility coordination handled in-house. Most single-panel upgrades complete in one day.

services.name: Lighting Installation
services.description: Interior and exterior lighting — recessed cans, landscape lighting, fixture swaps, and smart-switch retrofits. Dimmer compatibility and wireless controls specified to match existing load calculations.

services.name: Generator Installation and Service
services.description: Generac and Kohler whole-home generator installation, gas-line coordination, and ongoing service agreements. Transfer-switch selection and load-shedding configuration per household priority.

services.name: AC Maintenance and Tune-ups
services.description: Seasonal maintenance agreements for residential HVAC systems — spring AC tune-up and fall heat check, with priority dispatch during peak-demand weeks. Filter replacements tracked per unit.

services.name: HVAC System Installation
services.description: Full system replacements, heat-pump conversions, and duct modifications for homes under 4,000 square feet. Manual-J load calculations performed in-house before equipment sizing — no stock recommendations.

services.name: Emergency HVAC Service
services.description: Same-day and after-hours emergency HVAC response across Marion County during peak summer and winter weeks. Most residential emergency calls reach the home within two hours of dispatch.

services.name: Drain Cleaning and Repair
services.description: Mechanical drain clearing, hydrojetting, and camera-inspection diagnosis for residential mainlines and branch drains. Root-intrusion spot repairs available without full-yard excavation.

services.name: Water Heater Service and Replacement
services.description: Tank and tankless unit repair, replacement, and efficiency upgrades. Most residential water heater replacements complete in a single visit. A.O. Smith and Rinnai stocked on the trucks.

services.name: Full Re-pipe Service
services.description: Whole-home re-pipe in PEX for homes with aging copper or polybutylene plumbing. Three to five day turnaround with water service restored nightly. Wall-opening and patching coordinated in-house.

serviceAreaRegion: Central Florida — Marion County + neighboring Sumter and Lake county service on request.

featuredPromotion.text: $49 diagnostic call across all three trades — applied to the repair if you proceed.

guarantees.type: licensed in plumbing, electrical, and HVAC — three trades under one contractor
guarantees.source: home page hero + About page + credential display at counter

guarantees.type: one-year workmanship guarantee across all trades
fully insured — general liability and workers comp

testimonials.name: Deborah R.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Used Summit for a panel upgrade last spring. Used them again in the fall when the AC died. Same company, same quality, one phone number. Worth every dollar.
testimonials.quoteShort: Panel upgrade in spring, AC in fall. Same company, same quality, one phone number.

testimonials.name: Marcus H.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Generator install. Greg himself did the walkthrough. Gas coordination, transfer switch, load-shedding config all handled. First outage a week later proved it out.
testimonials.quoteShort: Generator install. Walkthrough, gas coordination, transfer switch, load-shedding. First outage proved it out.

testimonials.name: Angela W.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Water heater replacement. In and out in three hours. One small nick on the wall paint that they offered to patch; I declined. Honest work.
testimonials.quoteShort: Water heater replacement in three hours. Offered to patch one small wall nick. Honest work.

testimonials.name: Thomas P.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Full re-pipe in PEX. Five days, water back on each night. Summit coordinated the permit, the drywall patching, and the fixture reinstall. Single point of contact throughout.
testimonials.quoteShort: PEX re-pipe, five days. Summit coordinated permit, drywall, fixtures. Single point of contact.

testimonials.name: Linda K.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: HVAC annual tune-up in June, emergency call in August when the unit iced over, full system replacement in September. Same tech every visit. That continuity matters.
testimonials.quoteShort: Tune-up in June, emergency in August, replacement in September. Same tech every visit.

testimonials.name: Robert D.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Lighting retrofit — kitchen, office, two bathrooms. Dimmer compatibility tested on each circuit before the final fixtures went in. No post-install surprises.
testimonials.quoteShort: Lighting retrofit, four rooms. Dimmers tested per circuit. No post-install surprises.

testimonials.name: Maria C.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Called Summit for drain cleaning. They diagnosed root intrusion with the camera, did a spot repair rather than recommending a full mainline replacement. Saved me six thousand dollars.
testimonials.quoteShort: Root intrusion found with camera, spot repair not full mainline replacement. Saved me six thousand dollars.

testimonials.name: Kevin T.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Emergency HVAC call on the hottest day of the year. Summit was there in ninety minutes. Capacitor replacement, system back online. Fair price for the urgency.
testimonials.quoteShort: Emergency HVAC on the hottest day. On-site in 90 minutes. Fair price for the urgency.

testimonials.name: Jennifer L.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Manual-J load calc before they specified the new AC. Summit explained why the previous contractor's recommendation was one ton oversized. Right-sized system, lower bills.
testimonials.quoteShort: Manual-J load calc before sizing. Previous contractor was a ton oversized. Right-sized, lower bills.

testimonials.name: David W.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Panel upgrade from 150 to 200 amps. Permit, utility coordination, and inspection all handled in one business day. Texts confirming each stage as it finished.
testimonials.quoteShort: 150-to-200 amp panel upgrade. Permit, utility, inspection in one business day. Text updates per stage.

testimonials.name: Rachel M.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Kohler whole-home generator install. Summit's configuration walked through priority-circuit load-shedding for our specific household. Worked flawlessly in October outage.
testimonials.quoteShort: Kohler generator install with priority-circuit load-shedding configured per household. Worked in October outage.

testimonials.name: Steven J.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Tankless water heater install. Original quote did not include gas-line upsize that turned out to be required. Summit absorbed half the overage. Honest negotiation.
testimonials.quoteShort: Tankless install. Gas-line upsize not in quote. Summit absorbed half the overage.

testimonials.name: Christina B.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Our vacation rental had three failing systems at once — AC, water heater, and a tripped breaker. Summit sent three specialists one morning and cleared everything before check-in.
testimonials.quoteShort: Three failing systems. Three specialists one morning. All cleared before guest check-in.

testimonials.name: Gregory N.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Summit has maintained our AC for eight years. Twice when the compressor failed they honored replacement rather than repair because the unit was close to end-of-life and repair made no sense.
testimonials.quoteShort: Eight years of AC maintenance. Twice honored replacement over repair when repair made no sense.

testimonials.name: Natalie F.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Smart-switch retrofit across the house — ten rooms, two dimmer brands, one hub. Summit's electrician stayed until the app paired every single one. Thorough work.
testimonials.quoteShort: Smart-switch retrofit across ten rooms. Electrician stayed until the app paired every one.

testimonials.name: Peter O.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: HVAC replacement plus duct rework for airflow. Summit's Manual-D duct calc caught a return-air sizing issue that would have kept the system underperforming. Fixed before install.
testimonials.quoteShort: HVAC plus duct rework. Manual-D caught a return-air sizing issue. Fixed before install.

testimonials.name: Samuel K.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Leak detection in a slab. Took two visits to isolate but Summit only charged one diagnostic call. Repair handled cleanly through a small slab cut.
testimonials.quoteShort: Slab leak detection took two visits. Charged one diagnostic. Repair through a small slab cut.

testimonials.name: Beth V.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: We've used Summit for every trade over the last six years. Panel, HVAC, plumbing, generator. The billing is consistent, the work is consistent, the crew is consistent.
testimonials.quoteShort: Six years, every trade. Billing consistent, work consistent, crew consistent.
